name: Jacuzzi Splot
original_name: ジャグジー・スプロット
source:
Gang leader.
He's the leader of a group of delinquents based in Chicago, despite the fact that he's a habitual crybaby. He has a tattoo resembling a sword on the left side of his face. He's at war with the Russo Family.

[Translated from in-game profile]
